facts.business: TGIF Agribusiness Limited is a horticulture-focused agribusiness company engaged in the cultivation, harvesting, processing, and marketing of fruits, vegetables, and plantation crops, primarily pomegranates, across 110 acres in Rajasthan.

auditor.name: M/s. Samir M. Shah & Associates, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Dependence on weather conditions including drought and natural disasters
Adverse impact of temperature changes, weather patterns, and extreme weather on crop growth and production
Volatility in commodity prices due to adverse weather conditions
Seasonal variations in harvest and supply
Risk of improper demand estimation leading to shortage of farm produce
Storage limitations affecting produce quality during off-periods
